But the record still lacks the final disclosed artifact, lacks approved risk acceptance, and lacks an approved mitigation with the required policy elements. So the Actor's narrowed position is directionally plausible, yet still unresolved on a required compliance condition. That is enough to preserve suspicious rather than soften to compliant_with_caveats.
